optimized_code:
import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import pearsonr

# Data Loading
# Ensure the data is loaded correctly from the CSV file
df = pd.read_csv('table_name.csv')

# Check for missing values in the relevant columns
df = df.dropna(subset=['Preqin Median Net IRR', 'LN PME Using S&P 500 TR'])

# Statistical Analysis
# Calculate the Pearson correlation coefficient and p-value
corr, p_value = pearsonr(df['Preqin Median Net IRR'], df['LN PME Using S&P 500 TR'])

# Execution
# Output the results of the correlation test
print("Correlation Method: Pearson")
print(f"Correlation Coefficient: {corr}")
print(f"P-value: {p_value}")
